description: A second provider added beside ollama for any OpenAI-compatible service. The file names the variable that holds your key and never holds the key itself.

steps.description: This is a second provider entry, added next to `ollama` inside `provider`. Any service with an OpenAI-compatible address can go here, and the page says the file names the variable that holds your key and never holds the key itself.
The provider is named `ursinus`. `npm` is the same adapter package, and `name` is the display label, `Ursinus AI`.
`options` holds `baseURL` at `https://ursinus.ai/api/v1` and `apiKey` set to `"{env:URSINUSAI_API_KEY}"`. That is the name of a variable, not its value.
`models` maps `MODEL-NAME` to a display name, with `tools` set to true. The page says to replace `MODEL-NAME` with a model your key can use and choose it with `/models` inside opencode.
